readme:
# Njuskalo.hr Scraper

Scrape classified listings from [Njuskalo.hr](https://www.njuskalo.hr), a Croatian classifieds platform.

## How it works

1. Go to [njuskalo.hr](https://www.njuskalo.hr), open a category and set your filters
2. Copy the search URL and paste it into `searchUrls`
3. Set the maximum number of listings and run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search URLs, with automatic pagination.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/njuskalo-hr-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `njuskalo-hr-scraper` to scrape company data from njuskalo hr. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `title` | Listing title |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in EUR |
| `location` | City or area |
| `category` | Listing category |
| `image_url` | Main image |
| `posted_at` | Publication date |
| `source_url` | Link to listing on Njuskalo.hr |

## Pricing

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Start | $0.001 per run |
| Listing | $0.002 per listing |

**100 listings = $0.201** | **1,000 listings = $2.001**

## Examples

### Apartments for sale
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.njuskalo.hr/prodaja-stanova"
  ],
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Used cars with filters
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.njuskalo.hr/auti/audi?price[max]=20000&yearManufactured[min]=2010&yearManufactured[max]=2024"
  ],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### Several searches in one run
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.njuskalo.hr/prodaja-stanova",
    "https://www.njuskalo.hr/auti/audi?price[max]=20000"
  ],
  "maxResults": 200,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 100
}
```
